capabilities: : Replace local image links with remote URLs
: Bulk hoist images in a note
extras: Requires editor to be in Source Mode to function.
intentEvidence: Automatically move your local images to the cloud (ImgBB) to keep your Obsidian vault lightweight and your notes easy to share.
motivation: To keep the Obsidian vault lightweight and notes easy to share by moving images to the cloud.
problem: Storing large local images in the vault increases file size and can lead to broken links when content is shared externally.
summary: A tool that automatically uploads local vault images to ImgBB and replaces them with remote links to optimize storage and improve sharing.
